lea.text: Talrand is the warlord who conquers the Shandalar merfolk kingdom.

m13.text: Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar and turned his ambitions skyward, allying with the drakes of the Kapsho Sea against the dragons.
The dragon Kalyntri, who recalls that Talrand once escaped a blast of flame in one of his lairs, spots him standing on the open water beneath a lone dark storm cloud and swoops to kill him.

Talrand tells him "I didn't want to have to kill you," and uses fog, geysers and water walls to evade the flames until he announces that he brings the dragon rain, and dozens of drakes fall on Kalyntri from the storm cloud.
Talrand gives Kalyntri to a large drake as promised, and the drake bites through the dragon's neck, ending his rule.
